trust_boundaries.name: L1 caller -> ShieldedPool.applyBlock
trust_boundaries.assumption: Any EOA can call applyBlock; the only gate is IWhirVerifier.verify(statement, proof).

trust_boundaries.name: proof bundle -> WhirVerifier.verify
trust_boundaries.assumption: The whole bundle (CONFIG, PROOF, STATEMENT sections) is caller-controlled calldata; soundness requires CONFIG to be pinned to the honest block circuit.

trust_boundaries.name: client transfer proof -> block circuit
trust_boundaries.assumption: Child proofs are produced by the wallet (or by the node on the demo path) and re-verified in-circuit with a verifier retained by the node.

trust_boundaries.name: wallet -> node HTTP API
trust_boundaries.assumption: Submitter-token holders post SPHINCS+ envelopes; admin holds demo prover and settlement.

trust_boundaries.name: node env -> prover soundness parameters
trust_boundaries.assumption: WHIR security level, soundness regime, rates and PoW floors are read from process environment variables in library code.

unresolved_assumptions: Which CONFIG digest(s) a production deployment is meant to accept (block circuits differ per shape: n and (nin,nout) per child).
Whether SPHINCS+ spend authorization is meant to be enforced by the proof or only by the node.
Whether the settlement (non-ZK since a54c197) proof witnesses any secret material.

open_findings.summary: WhirVerifier takes the circuit description (CONFIG: preprocessed digest, degree bits, WHIR schedules, constraint programs) from the caller-supplied bundle and never pins it; applyBlock is permissionless; any party can prove an arbitrary circuit whose public values form a block statement and rewrite both pool roots.

WHIR opening points (per-matrix zeta / zeta_next) used to build the terminal-weight eq groups are read from the caller-supplied STATEMENT section of the bundle (TerminalWeight.deriveGroupDescs, TerminalWeight.sol:186-192) while the constraint identity rescales the bound evaluations with the transcript zeta (TerminalWeight.sol:1100-1149); no comparison between the two was found. Needs fp-check: if confirmed, the PCS claims are not bound to the DEEP point even with CONFIG pinned. UPDATE: agent A forge experiment (scratch test/agentA/StmPoint.t.sol) - replacing the round-1/2/3 statement-table opening point in block_composed_bundle.bin with z' != zeta still yields verify()==true; the STATEMENT section is never absorbed into the transcript.

Per-round WHIR batchCommitment (WhirVerifier.sol:~1027) is read from PROOF and never compared with the mainDigest/quotDigest/permDigest absorbed by BatchTranscript (BatchTranscript.sol:91/100/124/139) or the CONFIG preDigest.

QFOLD/MROOTS pruned query walk (TerminalWeight.sol:329-337, 665-673) dedups repeated query indices without checking the duplicate rows agree; p3-merkle-tree rejects InconsistentDuplicateOpenings (mmcs/mod.rs:563-572).
